faqs.question: Which is better, Nothing Phone 3 or 3a Pro?
faqs.answer: Phone 3 is the higher-performance flagship-style option, while Phone 3a Pro can offer stronger value and a dedicated periscope zoom at a lower tier. Compare the final local total and your priorities.

faqs.question: Which has the faster processor?
faqs.answer: Nothing Phone 3 is positioned with a higher-tier Snapdragon platform than Phone 3a Pro’s Snapdragon 7s Gen 3. Real gains depend on games, heat, storage and software.

faqs.question: Which camera is better?
faqs.answer: Phone 3 offers a more advanced multi-camera package, while 3a Pro’s 50MP periscope is a useful zoom advantage. Compare daylight, portraits, night scenes, video and processing rather than megapixels alone.

faqs.question: Does Phone 3a Pro zoom farther than Phone 3?
faqs.answer: Phone 3a Pro officially highlights a 50MP periscope with 3x optical and up to 60x ultra zoom. Phone 3 has its own telephoto system and processing; confirm exact regional camera specifications.

faqs.question: Which has the better display?
faqs.answer: Phone 3 is the higher-tier display choice, while Phone 3a Pro offers a large 120Hz AMOLED panel with strong brightness positioning. Test both outdoors if screen quality matters.

faqs.question: Which has better battery and charging?
faqs.answer: Phone 3 is positioned with a larger feature set and faster charging options, while 3a Pro is designed for long daily use. Runtime still depends on signal, brightness, gaming and background apps.

faqs.question: Is Nothing Phone 3 PTA approved?
faqs.answer: PTA status belongs to the exact device and IMEI process. Ask the seller who handles registration, keep the invoice and do not infer approval from another country or storage version.

faqs.question: Is Phone 3a Pro officially available in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Availability varies by channel. Confirm stock, model code, storage, colour, warranty and return route before treating an imported offer as a local product.

faqs.question: Which is better for gaming?
faqs.answer: Phone 3 is the stronger choice for demanding games and sustained performance headroom. Phone 3a Pro can handle everyday gaming and moderate settings with a potentially lower total cost.

faqs.question: Which phone has longer software support?
faqs.answer: Phone 3 launched later and sits higher in the range, but confirm the official support policy for both exact models and regions rather than inferring a guarantee from positioning.

faqs.question: Which local Nothing phones should I compare?
faqs.answer: Compare the verified Nothing Phone 3, Nothing Phone 3a and Nothing Phone 4a listings, then decide whether imported Phone 3a Pro value offsets its support and PTA uncertainty.

faqs.question: Should I buy Phone 3 just for the camera?
faqs.answer: Buy it for the complete package of performance, cameras, display, charging, software and support. Choose 3a Pro when its periscope zoom and lower verified total better match your real photography.
